memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: From heaven he made you hear his voice to discipline you. On earth he showed you his great fire, and you heard his words from out of the fire. Because he loved your ancestors and chose their descendants after them, he brought you out of Egypt by his Presence and his great strength, to drive out before you nations greater and stronger than you and to bring you into their land to give it to you for your inheritance, as it is today. - Deut 4:36-38 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses reveals the deep motivation behind all of God's mighty acts: "Because he loved your ancestors and chose their descendants after them." God's redemption of Israel flowed from His love. He did not rescue them because they were impressive or deserving, but simply because He set His love upon them. Love was the reason behind the exodus, the reason behind the covenant, the reason behind everything.

This is astonishing when we consider it. The God of the universe, the consuming fire, the one true God, loved His people and chose them. His discipline, His revelation, His powerful acts of deliverance — all of it was the expression of His love. God's people were loved, chosen, and led by a God whose heart was for them.

The same is gloriously true for all who belong to God through Christ. Scripture tells us that God chose us in Christ before the creation of the world, in love (Eph 1:4-5). Our salvation flows not from our worthiness but from God's love. We love Him because He first loved us (1 John 4:19). Everything God has done for us — from creation to the cross to His daily care — springs from His love.

We must guard against thinking we earn God's favour. We are loved not because of what we have done, but because of who God is. He set His love on us freely, chose us graciously, and leads us faithfully. When we grasp that we are loved, chosen, and led by such a God, it transforms us. We rest in His love, we walk in gratitude, and we give ourselves fully to the One who first gave Himself for us. You are loved by God — let that truth shape your whole life.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you rest in the truth that you are loved and chosen by God?
2. How does knowing God's acts flow from love change your view of Him?
3. How does being loved "because He first loved us" free you from earning His favour?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Loving God, thank You that You loved and chose me, not because of my worth but because of who You are. Help me rest in Your love, walk in gratitude, and give myself fully to the One who first loved me in Christ. Amen.
